de.abas.eks.jfop.remote

Class CommunicationException

  • Object
    • Throwable
      • Exception
        • RuntimeException
          • CommunicationException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    ConnectionLostException

    public class CommunicationException
extends RuntimeException
    Occurs when there is an error in the connection between abas ERP and the JFOP server. These are individual processes which communicate with eachother. The cause of an error in this communication could be, for example, a resource problem of the computer, a kill or a different conditional end of the respective abas ERP, an unexpected and unpermitted server response or an external program which writes onto the used port without permission. The error can potentially occur in the case of every method call of the classes EKSe or FOe. As a RuntimeException, this Exception does not have to be declared and it does not have to be caught. In this case the JFOP ends and a respective error message appears in abas ERP. This Exception can also be caught. However, all other requests to abas ERP also trigger this Exception; it does not make sense to use these. However, "clean up work" can be done, e.g. temporary files can be deleted.
